$comment: GENERATED from hadron-cli internal/skilldoc by the #1177 fixture generator (scripts/skilldoc-fixtures/). The hash / render / renderParseRoundTrip sections were REGENERATED at 1d8ca46 for #1235 (§4a: the node id leads the hash), which changed EVERY digest in them — an empty id contributes the empty string rather than being skipped, so pre-§4a inputs move too. render and renderParseRoundTrip are kept NAME-ALIGNED because the round-trip test looks its inputs up in render by case name, and renderParseRoundTrip records what Go READ BACK (post-NormalizeBody). Sections not listed still date from 973cd1f. Language-neutral: the Go and TypeScript suites both load this file, so a port that diverges reds rather than passing its own restatement of itself. Regenerate rather than hand-edit.  D12 (2026-09-19) retired name derivation and the org prefix, so the deriveName and validPrefix sections were removed; validName survives and now validates a STORED name.  The `lint` and `lintCollisions` sections were generated later, at 1a8036b (recorded separately as lintSourceCommit): the earlier sections predate D12, and regenerating them wholesale would have mixed a re-measurement into a port. Both commits are on main; neither section has been hand-edited.  #1289 (2026-09-23): `lintCollisions` is now REGENERATED by genfix.go at 3c30a38 (hadron-cli#678, where Go counts enabled declarations only), stamped separately as lintCollisionsSourceCommit; its inputs are authored in genfix (collisionCases) and now carry enable, since pre-#1289 inputs had none and would have stopped colliding on both sides. `lint` stays at lintSourceCommit. The same run restamped sourceCommit to 3c30a38; the hash / render / renderParseRoundTrip bytes it recomputed are unchanged.  #1292 (2026-09-23): `declared` is now REGENERATED by genfix at e67ff80 (hadron-cli#679, where an unknown exports key is never shape-checked), stamped declaredSourceCommit, and each case gains `unknown` (Go UnknownHostKeys, UTF-8 byte order). Its two ordering cases now expect an empty `malformed` and carry their order in `unknown`. The same run restamped sourceCommit and lintCollisionsSourceCommit to e67ff80 with every other section byte-identical.  #1292, @copilot on PR #1296: `lintUnknownHostKeys` is GENERATED by genfix at e67ff80 (stamped lintUnknownHostKeysSourceCommit) from keys authored in genfix, chosen for the characters Go %q and JSON.stringify quote differently, and pins the warning message word for word.  #1315 (hadron-cli#712, merged as b138e65): `lintReserved` is GENERATED by genfix at b138e65 (stamped lintReservedSourceCommit) from nodes authored in genfix (reservedCases), and pins Claude's reserved `synced` name PER HOST through Go's LintFor over every host row (`findingsByHost`), word for word — the first version used the Claude-only Lint wrapper, so the Codex verdict was never evaluated (PR #1343 review). A section of its own so `lint` stays at lintSourceCommit. The same run restamped sourceCommit, lintCollisionsSourceCommit, declaredSourceCommit and lintUnknownHostKeysSourceCommit to b138e65, with every other section byte-identical.  #1341 (hadron-cli#722, PR #730 merged as c9fa75a): `lintMarkup` is GENERATED by genfix at c9fa75a (stamped lintMarkupSourceCommit) from nodes authored in genfix (markupCases): the twenty descriptions of the Cowork probe upload EXACTLY as uploaded, each named with its measured verdict, plus the unmeasured nested `<<>` (refused on purpose), the leftmost quoted span, a %q-escaped span, a printable non-ASCII span, a non-printable (U+200B) span Go's %q escapes, and markup beside too-long. PER HOST through LintFor, like lintReserved; both hosts declare every node, so the Codex column is a real verdict. The same run restamped sourceCommit, lintCollisionsSourceCommit, declaredSourceCommit, lintUnknownHostKeysSourceCommit and lintReservedSourceCommit to c9fa75a, with every other section byte-identical.  #1323 (2026-09-25): the new `parseHeader` section is Go's ParseFile at 9e7d2bd (hadron-cli#724, the first Go that reads `rev=`) over authored edits of one Go-rendered file: the `rev=` edge values (absent, 1, 7, the signed 32-bit maximum, one past it, eleven digits, 0, a leading zero, signs, a fraction, a trailing letter, a non-ASCII digit, key order, a repeated key, a wrong-case key) and whitespace-separator cases. Go reads `rev` 0 as none, which the port spells null. The separator cases found a pre-#1323 parity bug: RE2's \s is [\t\n\f\r ] while JavaScript's also takes \v and NBSP, so a header or legacy line Go voids read as ours in the port; fixed in parse.ts in the same change. Stamped parseHeaderSourceCommit. The same run restamped sourceCommit, lintCollisionsSourceCommit, declaredSourceCommit, lintUnknownHostKeysSourceCommit, lintReservedSourceCommit and lintMarkupSourceCommit to 9e7d2bd, with every other section value-identical.  #2943 (hadron-cli#1166, PR #1507 frozen head 3582c97): `lintTemplate` is GENERATED by genfix at 3582c97 (stamped lintTemplateSourceCommit) from contents authored in genfix (templateCases): an include tag `{{> part}}` gets no skill-content-has-template finding (the pattern skips a match whose first character is `>`), a placeholder still warns word for word. PER HOST through LintFor, like lintMarkup. The same run restamped sourceCommit, lintCollisionsSourceCommit, declaredSourceCommit, lintUnknownHostKeysSourceCommit, lintReservedSourceCommit, lintMarkupSourceCommit and parseHeaderSourceCommit to 3582c97, with every other section value-identical.
